name: plex-meta-manager
description: Plex-meta-manager(https://github.com/Kometa-Team/Kometa) is a Python 3 script that can be continuously run using YAML configuration files to update on a schedule the metadata of the movies, shows, and collections in your libraries as well as automatically build collections based on various methods all detailed in the wiki.

variables.name: PMM_CONFIG
variables.description: Specify a custom config file to use.

variables.name: PMM_TIME
variables.description: Comma-separated list of times to update each day. Format: `HH:MM`.

variables.name: PMM_RUN
variables.description: Set to `True` to run without the scheduler.

variables.name: PMM_TEST
variables.description: Set to `True` to run in debug mode with only collections that have `test: true`.

variables.name: PMM_NO_MISSING
variables.description: Set to `True` to run without any of the missing movie/show functions.
